0022600167.text: The Houston Rockets (6-1, 3-0 at home) host the Boston Celtics (5-1, 4-0 at home) in the Rockets' eighth game of the 2026-27 season, with Houston second in the Southwest and Boston on a five-game winning streak. Steven Adams is out for Houston with a calf strain, while Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Reed Sheppard (back) are listed as day-to-day. For Boston, Devin Carter is out with an illness and Mitchell Robinson is day-to-day with rest. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet this season, and the last meeting was on February 4, 2026, in Houston, where the Rockets lost 114-93.
